blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dynamic World (DW) maps land use and land cover globally at 10 m from Sentinel-2 (S2) imagery, but only for cloud-free observations, which limits where and when surface water can be mapped. We use the DW water class as weak supervision for a Sentinel-1 (S1) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) model so that DW-like water maps can be produced for every S1 acquisition. Google’s AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) annual embedding supplies spatial context, while S1 backscatter supplies the acquisition-time observation. On 53 globally distributed scenes with independent annotations of 3 m PlanetScope imagery acquired within 48 h of the S1 overpass, the S1-only model already reaches a pooled water intersection over union (IoU) of 0.77, comparable to 0.75 for the operational OPERA DSWx-S1 product, and adding AEF raises it to 0.85. The fused model improves on the S1-only model on 44 of 53 scenes and exceeds OPERA on 48, and on the independent S1S2-Water benchmark it reaches 0.94, compared with 0.87 for OPERA. Optical land-cover products can thus provide scalable training labels for SAR surface water mapping.
blocks.zh: 动态世界(DW)在全球从Sentinel-2 (S2)图像10米处绘制了土地利用和土地覆盖图,但只用于无云观测,这限制了地表水的测绘地点和时间. 我们使用DW水级作为Sentinel-1(S1)合成孔径雷达(SAR)模型的弱监督,这样每次获得S1时都可以制作出DW等水相图. Google的AlphaEarth基金会(AEF)每年嵌入提供空间背景,而S1回放则提供收购时间观测. 在53个全球分布的场景上,在S1过道48小时范围内获得的3m PlanetScope图像的独立说明中,仅S1型已经通向了集合水相交道口(IoU)为0.77,可与运行中的OPERA DSWx-S1产品相媲美为0.75,并加入AEF将其提升到0.85. 被引信的模型改进了53个场景中的44个的S1-Only模型,并在48个场景上超过了OPERA,在独立的S1S2-Water基准上达到了0.94,而OPERA则达到了0.87. 因此,光学用地覆盖产品可以为合成孔径雷达地表水绘图提供可扩展的培训标签。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Frequent surface water maps are needed to monitor river width and discharge [ 1 , 2 ] , lake and reservoir storage [ 3 ] , and flood exposure [ 4 ] . Dynamic World (DW) classifies 10 m Sentinel-2 (S2) images with less than 35% cloud cover in near real time [ 5 ] , but clouds and cloud shadows limit its valid coverage, particularly in the tropics [ 6 ] . Long-term optical water records such as the Joint Research Centre (JRC) Global Surface Water dataset share this limitation [ 7 ] . Sentinel-1 (S1) C-band synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observes through clouds, day and night [ 8 ] , and automated processing chains map water from its backscatter [ 9 ] , but smooth non-water surfaces, radar shadow, and other low-backscatter terrain can be confused with open water [ 10 , 11 ] . Operational SAR products therefore combine backscatter with static ancillary layers. OPERA DSWx-S1, for example, uses land cover, long-term water occurrence, and height above nearest drainage (HAND) to reduce such false detections [ 11 ] . We ask whether a model can reproduce DW water maps from S1 on cloudy days, complementing S2-based DW to increase observation frequency.
blocks.zh: 需要经常绘制地表水图来监测河流宽度和排出量[1,2],湖泊和水库贮存量[3],并进行洪水照射[4]. 动态世界分类 10 m Sentinel-2 (S2) 在近实时中云覆盖率低于35%的图像 [5],但云和云阴影限制了其有效覆盖,特别是在热带地区[6]. 由联合研究中心(JRC)全球地表水数据集等长期光学水分记录共享这一限制[7]. Sentinel-1(S1) C波段合成孔径雷达(SAR)通过云,昼夜[8]观测,并自动处理链从后散射出水图,但平滑的非水地表,雷达阴影等低后散射地可以与开水相混淆[10,11]. 因此,业务合成孔径雷达产品与静态辅助层相结合。 例如,OPERA DSWx-S1利用地表覆盖、长期出水量和最近的排水量(HAND)以上的高地来减少这种虚假检测[11]. 我们问一个模型是否能够在多云的日子复制S1的DW水图,补充基于S2的DW来增加观测频率.

blocks.en: To reduce false detections over radar-dark land, we add Google’s AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) embeddings as spatial context. AEF, one of several recent pixel-level embedding products [ 12 ] , compresses a year of optical, radar, lidar, and other Earth observations into a 64-dimensional embedding for each 10 m pixel [ 13 ] , encoding persistent land cover and, indirectly, water occurrence. Unlike rule-based masks, AEF lets the model learn which spatial context helps interpret SAR observations.
blocks.zh: 为了减少雷达暗地上的假探测,我们加入了谷歌的阿尔法地基(AEF)嵌入作为空间背景. AEF是最近几种像素级嵌入产物之一[12],将一年的光学,雷达,立达等地球观测压缩为每10米像素的64维嵌入[13],编码了持久的地表覆盖,并间接地将出水. 与基于规则的口罩不同,AEF让模型学习哪个空间上下文有助于解释SAR观测.

blocks.en: Optical products have supplied weak supervision for water mapping. Sen1Floods11 used S2 spectral-index labels for S1 models [ 14 ] , while DW labels have been used for fractional water mapping from 375 m VIIRS imagery [ 15 ] . We use DW labels for acquisition-specific 10 m SAR water mapping with annual AEF context. Other studies use AEF for U.S. post-event SAR flood segmentation [ 16 ] and benchmark foundation-model backbones for flood mapping [ 17 ] . Our focus is global surface water mapping with DW pseudo-labels rather than flood-event annotations.
blocks.zh: 光学产品对水上绘图的监督薄弱。 Sen1Flouds11在S1型号中使用了S2光谱-指数标签[14],而DW标签则用于从375 m VIIRS 成像上分分出分水图[15]. 我们使用DW标签来进行具有年度AEF背景的10米合成孔径雷达专项水测绘。 其他研究使用AEF进行美国事发后SAR分洪[16]和基准地基-模型干道进行洪灾测绘[17]. 我们的重点是全球地表水绘图,上面贴有DW伪标签,而不是洪灾事件说明。

blocks.en: This letter makes three contributions. First, we train an S1 water model on DW pseudo-labels alone, without manual annotation. Second, we isolate the contribution of annual AEF context with an S1-only baseline that shares the training data and schedule. Third, we evaluate both models against two references independent of DW, comprising 53 PlanetScope-based annotated scenes [ 18 ] and the S1S2-Water benchmark [ 19 ] , and compare them with the operational OPERA DSWx-S1 product [ 20 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 这封信有三分贡献。 首先,我们单独在DW假标签上训练一款S1水模型,没有人工注释. 第二,我们用共享培训数据和时间表的S1基准来孤立年度AEF背景的贡献。 第三,我们根据两个独立于DW的参考文献来评价这两个模型,其中包括53个基于PlanetScope的注解场景[18]和S1S2-水基准[19],并将它们与可操作的OPERA DSWx-S1产品[20,11]进行比较.

blocks.en: II Methods and Data
blocks.zh: 二. 方法和数据

blocks.en: II-A Weak Supervision from DW to S1
blocks.zh: II-A 从DW到S1的薄弱监督

blocks.en: Training sites were primarily sampled from the Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) River Database (SWORD) v16 river reaches [ 21 , 22 ] . We randomly selected 20% of river reaches on each continent and retained one S1–DW pair per sampled reach if acquisitions within 24 h of each other were available. We kept only pairs with at least 90% valid DW coverage, which left 4678 river tiles. Each tile covers approximately 10.7 km per side, including surrounding land. We then added 600 tiles centered on lakes, seasonal water, reservoirs, and coastal sites using the same pairing and coverage criteria (Supplementary Section S3). The label band of each paired DW image was converted to a binary mask (class 0, water → \rightarrow 1; all other classes → \rightarrow 0) and aligned pixel for pixel with the S1 tile; remaining no-data pixels were also set to 0. Labels therefore inherit DW classification errors [ 23 ] , surface water changes between paired acquisitions, and cloud-masking errors. The final dataset has 5278 co-registered S1 / AEF / DW triplets, split at random at the tile level (80/20, seeded) into 4222 training and 1056 validation tiles. For training, we sampled 512 × 512 512{\times}512 -pixel patches from these tiles. DW is used only as the training target; at inference the model receives S1 and AEF.
blocks.zh: 培训地点主要取自地表水和海洋地貌数据库(SWORD)v16河流取自[21,22]。 我们随机选择20%的河流到达每个大陆,如果在24小时之内可以购买,则每个取样的河流保留一对S1-DW。 我们只保留了至少90%有效的DW覆盖的对子,这留下了4678个河道瓷砖. 每块地砖每边约10.7公里,包括周围土地。 然后,我们又增加了600块以湖泊、季节性水、水库和沿海地点为中心的瓦片,采用了相同的配对和覆盖标准(补充部分S3)。 每对 DW 图像的标签带被转换为二进制口罩( 第 0 类, water →\rightarrow 1; 所有其他类 →\rightarrow 0),并将像素的像素与 S1 片对齐;剩下的无数据像素也被设定为 0 . 因此标签继承了 DW 分类错误 [23], 地表水在对接收购之间变化, 和云-相模错误. 最终数据集有5278个共同注册的S1 / AEF / DW 三重奏鸣曲,在平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地 为了训练,我们从这些瓷砖上抽取了512×512\512\times}512-像素补丁. DW只用作训练目标;推断模型得到S1和AEF.

blocks.en: II-B S1 and Annual AEF Fusion
blocks.zh: II-B S1和AEF年度组合

blocks.en: We obtained S1 ground range detected (GRD) imagery from the Google Earth Engine [ 24 ] COPERNICUS/S1_GRD collection (Interferometric Wide swath, dual VV/VH polarization), which provides calibrated, orthorectified σ 0 \sigma^{0} backscatter in dB. We stacked VV, VH, and the incidence angle relative to the ellipsoid ( angle band). The 64-band annual AEF embedding (v1, int8) was retrieved from the Source Cooperative archive [ 25 ] and reprojected to the S1 grid by nearest neighbor; it is constant within a calendar year and may include observations after the S1 acquisition. Each training tile uses the embedding of its acquisition year, except 98 tiles acquired in 2015–2016, before the first AEF year, which use the 2017 layer and therefore include later context.
blocks.zh: 我们从Google地球引擎(24) COPERNICUS/S1_GRD集(Interferometric)中获得了检测到的S1地程(GRD)图像. 宽相片,双相VV/VH两极分化),提供校正,正相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相 我们堆放了VV,VH,以及相对于椭圆(角度波段)的事件角. 从Source Corporation档案中取回了每年64个波段的AEF嵌入(v1, int8)并被最近的相邻者重新预测到S1网格;在一个日历年内是恒定的,可能包括S1收购后观测. 每块训练瓦都使用其获得年份的嵌入,除了在第一个AEF年份之前于2015–2016年获得的98块瓷砖,这些瓷砖使用2017年地层,因此包括后上下文.

blocks.en: S1 and AEF are fused at the input. A bias-free 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolution projects the 64 AEF bands to k = 16 k{=}16 channels. These channels are concatenated with the three S1 bands to form a 19-channel input to a U-Net [ 26 ] with an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-34 encoder [ 27 ] (Fig. 1 (a)). The model is trained in four fine-tuning stages using a combined cross-entropy and Dice loss and the Ranger optimizer, with early stopping based on validation water IoU within each stage. Input bands are standardized using training-set statistics. Training details are provided in Supplementary Section S3 and the code.
blocks.zh: S1和AEF在输入处被接通. 一个无偏差的 1 × 1 1 × 1 =times} 1 切入将64个AEF频段投放到 k = 16 k = 16个频道. 这些频道由三个S1频段相接而成,形成一个由19个频道输入的U-Net [26],并配有一款由ImageNet预装的ResNet-34编码器[27] (图1 (a)). 该模型在四个微调阶段进行训练,使用一款综合的交叉通取和Dice损失和"游侠"优化器,并基于验证水IoU在每个阶段内进行早期停放. 利用培训统计数据,将输入段标准化。 培训详情见补充部分S3和守则。

blocks.en: II-C Experimental Design
blocks.zh: II-C 实验设计

blocks.en: We compare S1-only and S1+AEF( t t ) models with the same training split, architecture, and schedule, differing only in the AEF input; t t denotes the S1 acquisition year. Both are trained with seeds 42–44; results use seed 42 unless otherwise stated. Additional analyses vary the projected AEF width and the training-set size (each over three seeds) and the embedding year (at inference and in training) (Section III-C ; Supplementary Section S4).
blocks.zh: 我们只比较S1-和S1+AEF(t t)模型与相同的训练分拆,架构,和时间表,仅在AEF输入中有所不同;tt表示S1获取年份. 两者都受过42-44个种子的培训;结果使用42个种子,除非另有说明。 其他分析则将AEF的预计宽度、培训设置的大小(每只用3个种子)和嵌入年份(推论和培训)(第三节C;补充部分S4)。

blocks.en: II-D Independent Evaluation and Product Comparisons
blocks.zh: II-D 独立评价和产品比较

blocks.en: The Global Surface Water Dataset (GSWD) [ 18 ] contains 100 manually annotated 3 m PlanetScope-based maps spanning rivers, lakes, urban areas, and diverse biomes. We retained 53 with S1 GRD within 48 h of PlanetScope (median 19.9 h). S1 and AEF were exported at the 10 m training resolution. Inference averages four-flip predictions on 512 × 512 512{\times}512 -pixel tiles with 64-pixel overlap; probabilities are bilinearly resampled to the 3 m reference grid before thresholding (Supplementary Section S2). Supplementary Section S5 tests inference on inputs resampled to 3 m.
blocks.zh: 全球地表水数据集(GSWD)[18] 载有100个人工附加说明的3米PlanetScope地图,横跨河流、湖泊、城市地区和不同的生物群落。 我们保留了53个在PlanetScope(中间值19.9小时)以内的S1 GRD。 S1和AEF在10米训练分辨率被输出出. 推论对512 × 512 512\times}512-像素瓦片与64-像素相重叠的4-flip预测平均值;概率在阈值前被双线重印到3米参考网格上(补充部分S2). S5节补充试验对输入的推论重新作样至3米.

blocks.en: GSWD and SWORD are independent sources, but training and evaluation sites were not geographically separated. Five evaluation scenes lie within 5 km of a training-tile centroid and eight within 11 km. Excluding these eight scenes leaves pooled S1+AEF water IoU essentially unchanged (0.855 for the remaining 45 versus 0.851 for all 53). The primary operating point is a fixed threshold of 0.30, selected from a DW-validation threshold sweep of an earlier model and retained to compare all reported models at the same operating point; it was not selected using GSWD or S1S2-Water reference labels. All methods are scored on the same pixels, those with reference values 0 or 1 and valid predictions from every model run and OPERA, comprising 93.4% of the reference grid; scoring each method on its own valid pixels changes no pooled or per-scene mean IoU by more than 0.01. We report pooled precision, recall, and Dice (F1), and water IoU aggregated in two ways. Pooled metrics aggregate confusion counts across scenes, whereas per-scene IoU gives each scene equal weight. Bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs) quantify uncertainty in the per-scene mean, and paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests evaluate within-scene differences between methods.
blocks.zh: 社发所和SWORD是独立来源,但培训和评价站点没有地理上分开。 5个评价场景位于1个训练-瓷砖中间体的5公里以内,8个在11公里以内. 不包括这8个场景,S1+AEF集水IoU基本上保持不变(其余45个场景为0.855个,而所有53个场景为0.851)。 主操作点是0.30的固定阈值,从早先的模型的DW-验证阈值扫描中选取,并保留以比较同一操作点上所有被报道的模型;它没有使用GSWD或S1S2-Water的参考标签来选择. 所有方法都在同一像素上打分,那些参考值为0或1,并且每个模型运行和OPERA的有效预测,由参考网格的93.4%组成;根据自己有效的像素来打分,每种方法不会使集合或人均IoU改变0.01以上. 我们报告集合精度、回想和滴水量(F1)和水一U以两种方式汇总。 组合度量衡 组合错位数 跨场景, 而平面 IoU 给予每个场景 相等的权重。 Bootstrap置信间隔(CIS)量化了每地平面平均值的不确定性,并配对的Wilcoxon签名排名测试评价了方法之间的在地平面差异.

blocks.en: We compare primarily with OPERA DSWx-S1’s 30 m B02_BWTR layer for the same S1 acquisition. Water includes inundated vegetation; HAND-excluded, layover/shadow, ocean, and no-data pixels are invalid. For overlapping OPERA product tiles (28 of 53 scenes), we union valid-pixel and water masks after nearest-neighbor resampling to 3 m. Published OPERA validation scores only entirely water or non-water 30 m pixels [ 11 ] ; we include all valid pixels, treating boundaries more strictly. Matched 30 m scoring and pure-reference blocks test resolution and boundary sensitivity (Supplementary Section S5). DW is assessed separately because no GSWD scene has a cloud-free DW map within ± \pm 4 days of PlanetScope (Section III-D ).
blocks.zh: 我们主要与OPERA DSWx-S1的30m B02_比较. 同一S1收购的BWTR层. 水包括被淹没的植被;HAND被排除在外,悬浮/阴影,海洋,和无数据像素无效. 对于重叠的OPERA产品瓦片(53场中的28场),我们结合有效像素和水面罩,在相近的邻居重新被复制到3米后. 已发布的OPERA验证评分仅为完全水或非水30米像素 [11];我们包括所有有效的像素,更严格地处理边界. 相匹配的30米积分和纯参考区块测试分辨率和边界敏感度(补充部分S5). DW被单独评估,因为GSWD的场景没有一张在PlanetScope ±\pm 4天之内的无云DW地图(第三节-D.

blocks.en: II-E S1S2-Water Benchmark
blocks.zh: S1S2-水基准

blocks.en: We evaluate 15 of 16 S1S2-Water test scenes [ 19 ] (Supplementary Table S1), excluding one whose source S1 acquisition could not be reproduced (Supplementary Section S1). These 100 km × \times 100 km scenes cover whole landscapes; water masks were manually refined by inspecting the S1 imagery. No benchmark data were used for training or threshold selection. OPERA was generated for the same acquisitions, and all methods are scored at 30 m on common valid pixels (Supplementary Section S1).
blocks.zh: 我们评估了16个S1S2水的试验场景中的15个[19](补充表S1),不包括其来源S1采购无法复制的场景(补充部分S一)。 这些100公里×相距100公里的场景覆盖了整个地貌;水口罩通过检查S1图像进行人工改进. 培训或门槛选择没有使用基准数据。 OPERA是为同样的收购而生成的,所有方法在普通有效像素上以30米的速度得分(补充部分S1).

blocks.en: III-A An S1-Only Model Trained on DW Labels
blocks.zh: III-A 只在DW标签上培训的S1-

blocks.en: Trained solely on DW water labels, S1-only reaches pooled IoU 0.768 on the independent PlanetScope reference, slightly above OPERA (0.747), and exceeds it on 36/53 scenes (Wilcoxon p < 0.05 p<0.05 ). Agreement with DW-independent labels supports optical supervision of SAR water mapping.
blocks.zh: 仅在DW水标签上接受过训练,在独立的PlanetScope参考(略高于OPERA(0.747))上,S1-只达到集合IoU 0.768,并在36/53场景上超过集合(Wilcoxon p < 0.05 p < 0.05). 与DW-独立标签的协议支持对合成孔径雷达水图进行光学监督。

blocks.en: III-B Annual AEF Context Improves the SAR Extension
blocks.zh: 三-B 年度AEF背景改进搜索和救援扩展

blocks.en: AEF raises pooled water IoU from 0.768 to 0.851 (Table I ), a gain of + 0.083 +0.083 with the same training split and schedule. Recall rises from 0.854 to 0.950; precision changes little (0.883 to 0.891). Fusion improves on 44/53 scenes (Wilcoxon p < 0.05 p<0.05 ), raising mean IoU from 0.62 (bootstrap 95% CI 0.53–0.70) to 0.74 (0.67–0.81) (Fig. 2 ). Gains are uneven, with a median of + 0.03 +0.03 , and 13 scenes with gains above 0.2 account for 85% of the summed gain; in six, S1-only misses most water (IoU below 0.2).
blocks.zh: AEF将集合水IoU从0.768提高到0.851(表一),收益为+0.083+0.083,同时采用相同的训练分出和时间表. 回顾从0.854上升到0.950;精度变化很小(0.883到0.891)。 合并在44/53场景上有所改进(Wilcoxon p < 0.05 p < 0.05),将平均IoU从0.62 (bootstrap 95% CI 0.53-0.70)提高到0.74 (0.67-0.81)(图2)。 增益不均匀,中位数为+0.03+0.03;增益大于0.2的13个场景占总增益的85%;在6个场景中,S1-只错过了大部分出水(IoU低于0.2).

blocks.en: In WorldCover [ 28 ] overlays, 77% of the false negatives corrected by AEF lie in WorldCover permanent water bodies, and 59% of the corrected false positives lie on bare or sparsely vegetated land. AEF also adds false positives, 62% of which lie in WorldCover permanent water bodies that the GSWD reference marks as dry, consistent with AEF encoding persistent water occurrence (Supplementary Section S4).
blocks.zh: 在"World Cover [28]"中,被"AEF"校正的假阴性77%位于"WorldCover"永久水体中,被校正的假阳性59%位于裸露或稀有的植物地上. AEF还添加了假阳性物质,其中62%位于World Cover永久性水体中,而GSWD参考为干燥,与AEF编码持续出水事件一致(补充部分S4).

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Per-scene water IoU for 53 scenes (10 m inference, threshold 0.30, common valid pixels). Curves show smoothed distributions, diamonds are means, and bars are bootstrap 95% CIs. Outlined circles, squares, and triangles mark SID23, SID46, and SID17 from Fig. 1 (b). S1+AEF( t t ) exceeds S1-only on 44/53 scenes and OPERA on 48/53 (Wilcoxon p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).
blocks.zh: 发相. 2:53场景(10米推想,0.30分阈值,常见有效像素)的有色水IoU. 曲线显示平滑的分布,钻石是手段,而条是靴子圈 95% CI. 外形圆形,正方形和三角形分别标有SID23,SID46和SID17从图1(b). S1+AEF(t t)在44/53场景上只超过S1-,OPERA在48/53场(Wilcoxon p < 0.05 p < 0.05).

blocks.en: TABLE II: Sensitivity Analyses on the 53 Surface Water Scenes (10 m Inference, Threshold 0.30, Common Valid Pixels; Mean ± \pm SD over Three Seeds)
blocks.zh: 表二:53个地表水场景的敏感性分析(10米推论,阈值0.30;普通有效像素;平均±\pm自毁于三种子)

blocks.en: III-C Sensitivity Analyses
blocks.zh: 三-C 敏感性分析

blocks.en: A single projected AEF channel, a learned combination of all 64 bands, captures 91% of the per-scene IoU gain achieved at k = 16 k{=}16 , accuracy is similar from k = 3 k{=}3 onward, and performance plateaus near 2000 training tiles in this experiment (Table II ). Replacing AEF( t t ) with AEF( t − 1 t{-}1 ) at inference, with the trained weights fixed, lowers pooled IoU from 0.851 to 0.846, retaining 94% of the gain over S1-only. A model trained and applied with AEF( t − 1 t{-}1 ) reaches 0.848, retaining 96% (Supplementary Section S4).
blocks.zh: 单一预测的AEF通道,由全部64个波段所学习到的组合,捕获了在k = 16 k{=}16 所实现的每场IoU增益的91%,精度与k = 3 k{=}3 接上相近,在本实验中,性能高地接近2000个训练瓦(表二). 用 AEF(t- 1 t{-} 1) 来取代 AEF( t-) 推论, 将训练有素的重量固定下来, 将集合的IoU从 0.851 降低到 0. 846 , 保留 94% 的收益 而不是 S1 。 用AEF(t- 1 t{-} 1)培训和应用的模型达到0.848,保留了96%(补充部分S4)。

blocks.en: III-D Comparison with Existing Products
blocks.zh: 三-D 与现有产品的比较

blocks.en: Against OPERA DSWx-S1, the fused model raises pooled IoU by 0.104 and improves on 48/53 scenes (median + 0.10 +0.10 , Wilcoxon p < 0.05 p<0.05 ), with higher precision and recall (Table I ).
blocks.zh: 针对OPERA DSWx-S1,被保险的型号将集成的IoU提升了0.104并改进了48/53场景(中间+0.10+0.10;Wilcoxon p < 0.05 p < 0.05),精度和召回率更高(表一)。

blocks.en: The advantage persists with matched resolution. Area-averaging probabilities and scoring both methods at 30 m gives pooled GSWD IoU 0.855 for S1+AEF versus 0.749 for OPERA, with fusion exceeding OPERA on 47/53 scenes. On entirely water or non-water reference blocks, IoU is 0.916 versus 0.825. Across scoring variants, the IoU difference between fusion and OPERA changes by at most 0.013 (Supplementary Table S2).
blocks.zh: 其优势在于有相应的解决办法。 区域射入概率和分数均为30米,使GSWD IoU 0.855用于S1+AEF,而OPERA为0.749,在47/53场景中聚变超过OPERA。 在完全水或非水参考区块上,IoU为0.916比0.825. 在整个评分变量中,聚变和OPERA之间的IOU差异变化最多为0.013(补充表S2)。

blocks.en: DW requires a nearby cloud-free observation. No GSWD scene has one within ± \pm 4 days of its reference, only two have one within ± \pm 8 days, and the median offset is 16 days; unlike training sites, GSWD scenes were not screened for DW coverage. Nearest cloud-free DW maps yield pooled IoU ≈ 0.60 {\approx}0.60 , partly reflecting this mismatch.
blocks.zh: DW需要附近的无云观测. 没有GSWD的场景在参考后 ±\pm 4 天内有一个,只有 2 个在 ±\pm 8 天内有一个,中位相抵为 16 日;与培训地点不同,GSWD的场景没有为DW覆盖进行筛选. 最接近无云 DW 地图生成集合 IoU 0.60 ~ 约 0.60 ,部分反映了这种不匹配.

blocks.en: TABLE III: Accuracy on the 15 S1S2-Water Test Scenes (30 m Grid, Threshold 0.30, Common Valid Pixels; Model Values Are Mean ± \pm SD over Three Seeds)
blocks.zh: 表三:15 S1S2-水测试场景的精确度(30米网格,下限0.30;常见有效像素;模型值为平均值±\pm SD大于三种子)

blocks.en: III-E Independent S1S2-Water Benchmark
blocks.zh: 三-E 独立S1S2-水基准

blocks.en: On S1S2-Water (Table III ), fusion exceeds OPERA on 12/15 scenes for every seed (Wilcoxon p < 0.05 p<0.05 ). S1-only does not differ consistently from OPERA ( p ≥ 0.56 p\geq 0.56 ); its errors are mainly false positives. On arid S1S2-Water scene 23 (0.8% water; Supplementary Table S1), it labels radar-dark terrain as water (IoU 0.03, mean over seeds), versus 0.81 for fusion and 0.83 for OPERA. OPERA exceeds fusion only on scenes 23, 35, and 82, by at most 0.04.
blocks.zh: 在S1S2-Water(表三)上,每个种子的聚变在12/15场均超过OPERA(Wilcoxon p < 0.05 p < 0.05). S1-只与OPERA(p 0.56 p\geq 0.56;其错误主要是假阳性. 在干旱的S1S2-水场景23(0.8%为水;补充表S1)上,它将雷达-暗地标为水(IoU 0.03,在种子上方为平均值),而聚变时标为0.81;OPERA时标为0.83. OPERA只在场景23,35和82上超过聚变,最多为0.04.

blocks.en: IV Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: DW pseudo-labels provide scalable optical supervision for S1 water mapping. Trained on them alone, the S1-only model matches or slightly exceeds OPERA DSWx-S1 on GSWD (0.77 versus 0.75), and annual AEF context improves accuracy on both GSWD and S1S2-Water. S1 supplies the acquisition-time observation; AEF is fixed within a calendar year and cannot by itself represent within-year changes in water extent. Its role is to supply spatial context for interpreting that observation.
blocks.zh: DW伪标签为S1水图提供可伸缩光学监督. 仅培训一次的S1型机车在GSWD上匹配或略高于OPERA DSWx-S1(0.77对0.75),每年的AEF背景提高GSWD和S1S2-Water的精度. S1提供购置时间观察;AEF在一个日历年内固定,本身不能代表水范围在年内的变化。 它的作用是提供空间背景来解释这种观察。

blocks.en: The two benchmarks highlight different S1-only errors, and AEF reduces both. On GSWD, AEF mainly recovers missed water, most of it in WorldCover permanent water bodies (Section III-B ); these overlays show where errors change, not why. On S1S2-Water, whose scenes cover whole landscapes with little water, S1-only errors are mainly false positives, and AEF raises precision from 0.81 to 0.95. The gain is concentrated in scenes where S1 alone fails.
blocks.zh: 这两个基准突出显示不同的S1-只错误,而AEF减少两者. 在全球社发运动方面,AEF主要回收漏取的水,大部分是在WorldCover永久性水体中(第三节-B节);这些覆盖显示错误在哪里变化,而不是为什么。 在S1S2-Water的场景以少水覆盖了整个地貌,而S1-只差错主要是假阳性,而AEF的精度从0.81提高到了0.95. 收益集中在S1独自失败的场景.

blocks.en: In these experiments, annual context also makes the model less sensitive to training and input choices. Across three training seeds, per-scene IoU varies less for the fused model than for S1-only (SD 0.001 versus 0.007, Table II ). Using the S1 images distributed with S1S2-Water instead of our Earth Engine S1 lowers pooled S1-only IoU from 0.82 to 0.72 but fused IoU only from 0.94 to 0.93, and running the network on GSWD inputs resampled to 3 m instead of the 10 m training grid lowers S1-only IoU from 0.77 to 0.57, while the fused model stays at 0.85 (seed 42; Supplementary Section S5). S1 preprocessing differs between processing chains, so this stability is useful in practice.
blocks.zh: 在这些实验中,年度背景也使得模型对培训和输入选择的敏感性降低. 在三种训练种子中,引信型号的每枚场景IoU比S1型小(SD0.001对0.007,表二)。 使用以S1S2-Water而不是我们的地球引擎S1分发的S1图像,将集成的S1型IoU从0.82降至0.72,但将IoU从0.94改为0.93,并将GSWD投入的网络运行在3米上,而不是10米训练网将S1型IoU从0.77降至0.57,而被集成型仍为0.85(见42;补充部分S5)。 S1预处理在处理链之间有所不同,因此这种稳定性在实践中是有用的.

blocks.en: The fused model was neither trained nor tuned on S1S2-Water, yet at native resolution (threshold 0.50, as in [ 19 ] ) its mean per-scene IoU (0.88) is close to the 0.85 reported for the best S1 model trained on that benchmark (Supplementary Section S5). Scene sets and averaging differ, so these results indicate transfer without retraining.
blocks.zh: 引信模型既没有经过训练,也没有在S1S2-Water上调用,但是在本地分辨率(阈值为0.50,如[19])下,其每层IoU的平均值(0.88)接近于为该基准培训的最佳S1模型报告的0.85(补充部分S5)。 场景设定和平均值不同,因此这些结果表明没有再培训的转移.

blocks.en: OPERA DSWx-S1 reduces errors over radar-dark land with fixed rules on static layers, including WorldCover, JRC water occurrence, and HAND [ 11 , 7 ] ; AEF serves a similar purpose but is learned jointly with S1 from the training labels. HAND could complement our model as an input, while learned embeddings could inform rule-based masks.
blocks.zh: OPERA DSWx-S1减少雷达黑暗地上的错误,对静地地层有固定规则,包括WorldCover,JRC出水,和HAND[11,7];AEF服务于类似目的,但与S1共同从训练标签中学习. HAND可以作为投入补充我们的模型,而所学入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入

blocks.en: Several limitations remain. Annual context can favor areas of persistent water, where most false positives added by AEF lie (Section III-B ). The model was not designed or evaluated for post-flood inundation. The model can also reproduce systematic DW label errors. The split is tile-level rather than basin-held-out, most training tiles (4678 of 5278) are centered on river reaches, and 10 m predictions have limited accuracy on narrow channels (Supplementary Section S5). Acquisition-year AEF can include observations after the S1 acquisition, so results with acquisition-year AEF are retrospective, not achievable in near real time. Prior-year AEF provides an alternative: using that layer, at inference or in training, retained 94–96% of the pooled IoU gain (Section III-C ). The approach still depends on continued AEF availability.
blocks.zh: 仍然存在若干限制。 年度环境可能有利于持久性水的领域,因为AEF在其中添加了大多数假阳性(第三节-B节)。 该模型并未被设计或评估为洪水后淹没. 该模型也可以再现系统性的DW标签错误. 分出地为平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平 收购年份的AEF可以包括S1收购之后的观测结果,因此收购年份的AEF的结果是可追溯的,无法在近实时实现. 上一年的AEF提供了一种替代办法:在推断或培训时,利用这一层次保留了集成的IoU收益的94-96%(第III-C节)。 这种办法仍然取决于是否继续提供非洲电子格式。

blocks.en: The pseudo-label dataset can expand as DW observations accumulate, and the same weak-supervision strategy could be tested with other SAR sensors. Together with optical observations, acquisition-specific S1 maps could support more frequent monitoring of river width, lake and reservoir area, and shorelines.
blocks.zh: 伪标签数据集可以随着DW观测的积累而扩展,同样的弱超视策略也可以用其他SAR传感器来测试. 在进行光学观测的同时,针对购置的S1地图可以支持更频繁地监测河流宽度、湖泊和水库面积以及海岸线。

blocks.en: Supplementary Material
blocks.zh: 补充材料

blocks.en: S1. S1S2-Water benchmark
blocks.zh: S1. S1S2-水基准

blocks.en: We use the Sentinel-1 reference masks for 15 of the 16 test scenes in S1S2-Water v1.0.1 [ 19 ] , [ 1 ] . Scene 31 was excluded before scoring because its source S1 acquisition could not be reproduced from its metadata and image encoding. The masks were initialized from the S2 normalized difference water index (NDWI) and manually corrected against each sensor’s image. S1S2-Water was assembled for general surface-water mapping rather than flood-event evaluation. “Flooded” in Table S1 denotes a land-cover class, not a documented flood event. No benchmark data were used for training or threshold selection.
blocks.zh: S1S2-Water v1.0.1 [19], [1]等16个试验场景中的15个,我们使用哨兵一号参照口罩. 场景31在评分前被排除在外,因为其来源S1获取无法从它的元数据和图像编码中复制. 这些口罩是从S2正常化差分水指数(NDWI)中初始化的,并对照每个传感器的图像进行人工校正。 S1S2-水的组装是为了进行一般地表水测绘而不是洪水事件评价. 表S1中的 " Flouded " 是指土地覆盖类别,而不是有记录的洪水事件。 培训或门槛选择没有使用基准数据。

blocks.en: Earth Engine S1 GRD VV, VH, and incidence angle were exported for the 22 source products underlying the 15 evaluated scenes, mosaicked in the order listed in the benchmark metadata, and paired with acquisition-year AEF on a 10 m grid. All three seeds use four-flip augmentation. Scoring uses a 30 m grid. Reference pixels are valid when at least 50% of their area is valid, and water when at least 50% of that valid area is water. Model probabilities are resampled bilinearly before thresholding; OPERA uses nearest neighbor. Common valid pixels cover 92.6–100% of the reference-valid area per scene.
blocks.zh: 地球引擎S1 GRD VV,VH,以及事件角被输出给15个评价场景所基于的22个源产品,按照基准元数据所列出的顺序进行拼接,并在10米网格上与收购年AEF对接. 所有三种种子都采用四氟增生法. Scoring使用30米网格. 参照像素在至少50%的面积有效时有效,而水在至少50%的有效面积为水时有效。 模型概率在阈值前被双线重印;OPERA使用相近的相邻. 常见的有效像素覆盖每个场景92.6-100%的参考-验证区.

blocks.en: Matching SLC acquisitions were processed with RTC-S1 v1.0.4 and DSWx-SAR v1.2, using Copernicus GLO-30 elevation, GLO-30 HAND, WorldCover 2020, and JRC water occurrence. Missing offshore elevation/HAND tiles were filled with zeros. We applied an upstream correction to the DSWx-SAR v1.2 edge-water exclusion to all scenes. B02_BWTR class 1 is water; HAND exclusion, layover/shadow, ocean, and no-data classes are invalid.
blocks.zh: 与SLC相匹配的收购是通过RTC-S1 v1.0.4和DSWx-SAR v1.2进行,使用哥白尼GLO-30高地,GLO-30 HAND,WorldCover 2020,和JRC出水. 缺失的近海高地/高地平地被零填入。 我们对DSWx-SAR v1.2边缘水排除法 对所有场景进行了上游修正。 B02_BWTR 第1类为水;HAND排除,悬浮/阴影,海洋,无数据类无效.

blocks.en: Table S1 uses the fixed 0.30 threshold of the main letter. Fig. S1 and the values below use threshold 0.50, selected on DW validation. At 0.50, fused pooled IoU is 0.953 ± 0.001 0.953\pm 0.001 versus 0.822 ± 0.024 0.822\pm 0.024 for S1-only and 0.869 for OPERA. Fused predictions exceed OPERA on 13–14 scenes across seeds (Wilcoxon p ≤ 0.001 p\leq 0.001 ).
blocks.zh: 表S1采用主字母的0.30固定阈值. 图. S1和在DW验证中选取的低于使用阈值0.50的数值. 在0.50时,只有S1型和OPERA型的引信集成IOU为0.953±0.001 0.953\pm 0.001,对0.822±0.024 0.822\pm 0.024。 在13至14个种子的场景上,虚假的预测超过了OPERA(Wilcoxon p.001 p\leq.001)。

blocks.en: TABLE S1: Per-scene water IoU on the 15 S1S2-Water test scenes (30 m grid, common valid pixels). S1-only and S1+AEF: mean ± \pm SD over three seeds, threshold 0.30 as in the main paper.
blocks.zh: 表格 S1: 在15 S1S2-水的测试场景(30米网格,常见的有效像素)上使用纯相片水IoU. S1-只和S1+AEF:指 ±\pm SD 在3个种子上,阈值为0.30,如正纸.

blocks.en: Fig. S1: Four S1S2-Water scenes showing S1 backscatter, reference water, and predictions from S1-only, S1+AEF, and OPERA. Models use seed 42 and threshold 0.50. IoU is scored at 30 m on common valid pixels.
blocks.zh: 图. S1:四个S1S2水上场景,显示S1回散相,参考水分,以及S1-只,S1+AEF,和OPERA的预测. 模型使用种子42和阈值0.50. IoU在常见的有效像素上得到30米的得分.

blocks.en: S2. PlanetScope reference evaluation
blocks.zh: S2. 行星 范围参考评价

blocks.en: The 53 GSWD reference scenes are 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 pixels at 3 m. Reference values 0 and 1 denote non-water and water, respectively, and are valid for scoring; any other value is excluded. S1–PlanetScope offsets have median 19.9 h, maximum 44 h, and are at most 24 h for 30 scenes. Inference uses 512 × 512 512\times 512 tiles with 64-pixel overlap and four-flip augmentation; probabilities are resampled bilinearly to the reference grid before thresholding.
blocks.zh: GSWD的53个参考场景为: 1024×1024 1024\times 1024像素在3m. 参考值0和1分别表示非水和水,且对打分有效;其他任何值均被排除在外. S1- 计划 范围偏移有中位数19.9小时,最高为44小时,30个场景最多为24小时。 推论使用512×512 512\times 512平方瓦,与64-像素相重叠并有4-flip扩能;概率在阈值前被双线再被复制到参考网格.

blocks.en: B02_BWTR class 1 includes open water and inundated vegetation; classes 250, 251, 254, and 255 are invalid. After nearest-neighbor resampling, overlapping products are combined by a union of valid pixels and a union of water (28 scenes, up to eight products).
blocks.zh: B02_BWTR 第1类包括开水和淹没植被;第250,251,254,和255类无效. 相邻再生后,由有效像素和水相结合(28场景,可达8场出品)将相接产品相接.

blocks.en: At threshold 0.50, pooled IoU is 0.86 for S1+AEF( t t ), 0.85 for the prior-year substitution, and 0.77 for S1-only. Figure 2 in the main paper uses 10,000 scene-bootstrap replicates (seed 42) for mean-IoU confidence intervals; paired tests use Wilcoxon signed ranks.
blocks.zh: 在0.50阈值下,集合IoU为:S1+AEF(t t)0.86;上年替代0.85;仅S1型0.77. 主论文中图2采用一万个场景-波纹复制(种子42)来进行中-IoU置信间隔;对接测试使用Wilcoxon签名排行.

blocks.en: S3. Training data and configuration
blocks.zh: S3. 培训数据和配置

blocks.en: Additional sampling sites came from the SWOT Prior Lake Database [ 2 ] , JRC Global Surface Water [ 7 ] , Global Dam Watch [ 3 ] , and GSHHG [ 4 ] . River tiles span October 2015–November 2025, with 95% in 2020–2022; other tiles span 2020–2023. The tile-level split uses seed 42.
blocks.zh: 其他取样点来自SWOT前湖数据库[2],联合审查委员会 全球地表水[7],全球 大坝观察[3],和GSHHG [4]. 河道瓦片跨度为2015年10月至2025年11月,2020-2022年占95%;其他瓦片跨度为2020-2023年. 瓦片平分使用42种种子.

blocks.en: The four fine-tuning stages comprise up to 2 frozen-encoder, 2 partially unfrozen, 10 fully unfrozen, and 10 tail epochs, with one-cycle learning rates of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} – 10 − 5 10^{-5} , 6 × 10 − 8 6\times 10^{-8} – 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} , and 1.5 × 10 − 7 1.5\times 10^{-7} – 1.5 × 10 − 6 1.5\times 10^{-6} , respectively. The code provides the full training configuration.
blocks.zh: 4个微调阶段由最多2个冷冻器,2个部分解冻器,10个完全解冻器和10个尾部纪元组成,单周期学习率为10-4 10-QQ-4},5×10-7 5\tims 10-Q-7}-10-5 10-10-5;6×10-8 6\tims 10-8;3×10-6 3\tims 10-6;和1.5×10-7 1.5\tims 10-6 10-6}分别组成. 代码提供了完整的训练配置.

blocks.en: Models were trained on NVIDIA A100 GPUs at the National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center (NERSC). Code, dependencies, and usage examples are provided at https:// github.com/Rohit18/surfaceWaterMappingGlobal (v1.0).
blocks.zh: 国家能源研究科学计算中心(NERSC)对NVIDIA A100 GPU进行了模型培训. 代码、依附关系和用法实例见https:// github.com/Rohit18/地表水映射全球 (v1.0).

blocks.en: S4. Model sensitivity and error patterns
blocks.zh: S4. 模型敏感性和出错模式

blocks.en: Replacing acquisition-year AEF with prior-year AEF at inference, with the S1+AEF weights fixed (seed 42, threshold 0.30), gives pooled IoU 0.846 versus 0.851 and per-scene mean 0.732 [95% CI 0.662, 0.797] versus 0.741 [0.669, 0.806], retaining 94% of the pooled gain over S1-only (0.768). The per-scene decrease has mean 0.009 and median 0.004 ( p = 0.004 p=0.004 ); the substituted model exceeds S1-only on 41/53 scenes ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 ).
blocks.zh: 将购置年的AEF替换为上年的AEF,推算,S1+AEF权重固定(种子42,阈值0.30),使集成IoU 0.846对0.851,而人均场均平均值为0.732 [95% CI 0.662, 0.797]对0.741 [0.669, 0.806],保留了94%的集合收益而仅比S1-(0.768). 人均场面下降为0.009和中位数0.004(p = 0.004 p = 0.004);替代型号在41/53场景(p < 0.01 p < 0.01)上仅超过S1-.

blocks.en: We also trained and applied the S1+AEF model ( k = 16 k{=}16 , seed 42, same schedule) with prior-year AEF. Its training set omits the 137 tiles acquired in 2015–2017, which have no prior-year layer, and one tile with less than 90% prior-year coverage (5140 of 5278 tiles). It reaches pooled IoU 0.848 and per-scene mean 0.734 [0.663, 0.800], retaining 96% of the pooled gain. It exceeds S1-only on 41/53 scenes and OPERA on 48/53 (both p < 0.05 p<0.05 ) and does not differ significantly from the acquisition-year model (mean per-scene difference 0.007, p = 0.07 p=0.07 ).
blocks.zh: 我们还培训和应用了S1+AEF模型(k = 16 k{=}16,种子42,同期)与上年的AEF. 它的训练集省略了2015-2017年获得的137块没有上一年分层的瓷砖,以及一块上一年覆盖率低于90%的瓷砖(5278块瓷砖中的5140块)。 它达到集合IoU 0.848,而人均值为0.734 [0.663,0.800],保留了集合收益的96%. 它在41/53场景上只超过S1,在48/53场景上超过OPERA(均取出:p < 0.05 p < 0.05),与收购年模型(平均人均差0.07,p=0.07 p=0.07)没有显著差异.

blocks.en: Overlaid on WorldCover 2021 [ 28 ] , using pixels valid in both models, the false negatives corrected by AEF (1.38 M pixels) lie mainly in permanent water bodies (77%) and mangroves (13%); the corrected false positives (0.84 M) lie mainly on bare or sparse vegetation (59%) and tree cover (20%); and 62% of the added false positives (0.81 M) lie in permanent water bodies. AEF raises scene IoU by more than 0.05 on 24 scenes, changes it by at most 0.05 on 26, and lowers it by more than 0.05 on three. These associations describe where errors occur, not their cause.
blocks.zh: 被覆盖于"2021年世界漫游" [28]上,使用两种模型中有效的像素,被AEF(1.38Mixels)所更正的假阴性主要位于永久水体(77%)和红树林(13%);被更正的假阳性(0.84M)主要位于裸露或稀疏的植被上(59%)和树皮上(20%);被添加的假阳性(0.81M)62%位于永久水体. AEF在24个场景上将场景IoU提升了0.05以上,在26个场景上最多更改了0.05个场景,并在3个场景上降低了0.05个场景. 这些协会描述了错误发生之处,而不是其原因。

blocks.en: S5. Input and scoring-resolution sensitivity
blocks.zh: S5. 投入和分数分辨率敏感性

blocks.en: Values are pooled IoU at threshold 0.30 for seed 42. On GSWD, we applied the network to inputs resampled to the native 3 m reference grid instead of the 10 m training grid. S1-only falls from 0.768 to 0.567 (recall 0.854 to 0.586), whereas S1+AEF changes little (0.851 to 0.853). Narrow river channels remain difficult to map, as illustrated by SID26, where fused IoU is 0.268 at 10 m versus 0.525 with 3 m inputs. On S1S2-Water, replacing our Earth Engine S1 with the benchmark-provided S1 lowers S1-only from 0.820 to 0.722 and S1+AEF from 0.939 to 0.934 (common valid pixels of the model runs, without OPERA).
blocks.zh: 价值在0.30的门槛值下集合出42个种子。 在GSWD方面,我们将网络应用于重新被复制到3米原始参考网格而不是10米培训网格的输入. S1-只从0.768降至0.567(回顾0.854降至0.586),而S1+AEF的变化很小(0.851降至0.853)。 如SID26所示,窄河道仍然难以绘制地图,其引信IoU在10米处为0.268,而投入为0.525。 在S1S2-Water上,用基准提供的S1将我们的地球引擎S1从0.820降到了0.722,而S1+AEF则从0.939降到了0.934(通用有效的模型像素运行,没有OPERA)来取而代之.

blocks.en: OPERA DSWx-S1 is a binary 30 m product, whereas our models predict probabilities at 10 m; on GSWD, the main paper resamples OPERA to 3 m by nearest neighbor and model probabilities bilinearly. We rescored the same predictions in four ways (Table S2 ). These comprise (i) both at 30 m, on 10 × 10 10\times 10 blocks of reference pixels, with area-averaged probabilities; blocks are valid if at least 50% of their area is valid and water if at least 50% of the valid area is water; (ii) the model thresholded on these blocks, like OPERA, and scored at 3 m; (iii) as (i), only on blocks entirely water or entirely non-water in the reference, as in the OPERA validation [ 11 ] ; and (iv) OPERA’s own grid, in the 46 scenes where all OPERA products share one grid. On S1S2-Water, model probabilities were area-averaged instead of resampled bilinearly. The S1+AEF–OPERA difference changes by at most 0.013. S1-only stays slightly above OPERA on GSWD at 30 m (35/53 scenes; p = 0.019 p=0.019 at 0.30, p = 0.057 p=0.057 at 0.50).
blocks.zh: OPERA DSWx-S1是二进制的30米产品,而我们的模型预测概率为10米;在GSWD上,主要纸张将OPERA由相邻最近的相邻者复制到3米,模型概率为双线. 我们从四个方面重新记录了同样的预测(表S2)。 其中包括:(一) 在30米处,在10×10个10个参照像素上,有面积平均概率的10个区块;如果至少50%的面积有效,区块有效;如果50%的有效面积为水,则区块有效;(二) 在这些区块上划出阈值的模型,如OPERA, 得分为3米;(三) 如OPERA验证[11]一样,在参考区块上,只有完全取水或完全取出非取水的区块有效;以及(四) OPERA自己的网格,即所有OPERA产品共用一个网格的46个场景。 在S1S2-Water上,模型概率是平均面积的,而不是双线重印. S1+AEF-OPERA差异变化最多为0.013. S1-仅略高于OPERA对GSWD的30米(35/53场景;p=0.019 p=0.019 在0.30,p=0.057 p=0.057 在0.50.

blocks.en: At the native S1S2-Water resolution and threshold 0.50, mean per-scene IoU is 0.748 ± 0.018 0.748\pm 0.018 (S1-only) and 0.876 ± 0.002 0.876\pm 0.002 (fused), compared with 0.850 for the best published S1 model [ 19 ] . The published evaluation includes scene 31 and uses weighted scene averages, whereas we give each of the 15 evaluated scenes equal weight.
blocks.zh: 在原生的S1S2水溶液和阈值为0.50,平均人均一氧化铀为0.748±0.018 0.748\pm 0.018(仅限S1)和0.876±0.002 0.876\pm 0.002(已使用),而最佳公布的S1型号为0.850 [19]. 公布的评价包括场景31,并采用加权场景平均值,而我们给予15个被评价场景中的每个场景同等分量.
